entry.description: `TelnetAppender` now listens on `127.0.0.1` by default instead of every interface. The stream is unauthenticated and unencrypted, so any host that could reach the port could read the application's log, and every documented example already used loopback. Watching the log from another machine is now opt-in: set `listenAddress` to `0.0.0.0` or `::` to restore the old behaviour. The `SocketHandler(port, sendTimeoutMillis)` constructor defaults the same way (audit da18b6fd-f012, implemented by @FreeAndNil)
